turns.text: I reported a scrape on the print, and your reply said it was part of the artwork. It's a raised scratch across the ink. I'd like to dispute that decision.
A colleague will take over to review the earlier decision about the raised scratch across the ink.

input.summary: Customer says they previously reported a scrape on the print and was told it was part of the artwork. They dispute that decision, describing it as a raised scratch across the ink. Please review the prior damage assessment and advise the customer.
